title: Retired teacher, parcel with drugs, crime branch

Q1.detail: The officer from Mumbai Crime Branch said my money must be verified, so I am transferring it to the account they gave.

Q2.detail: Officer Sharma from the Crime Branch told me to transfer it today.

Q3.detail: No, it is a government verification account.

Q4.detail: Yes, a courier company first, then the police. They said a parcel in my name had drugs and five passports.

Q5.detail: They told me this is a confidential investigation and I must not tell my children.

Q6.detail: Yes, on video since this morning.

Q7.detail: They said it will be refunded after the investigation is over.

Q8.detail: They said a warrant is issued and I will be arrested tonight.

Q9.detail: They sent an arrest warrant with a court stamp on WhatsApp.

Q10.detail: They said if I call anyone the case gets worse.
